title: Emrys and the Harvest
author: Coral Thornbury
blurb: Ada Brightwater, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
